kind: analyze (near-field radiative heat flux across a 10 nm vacuum gap between isotope-engineered BAs half-spaces: three composition series of hot/cold pairs plus the eps_inf baseline; total-flux positions, ratios and orderings)
provenance: 3_reproduction/L9/result.json (guards G6-G12 with the reviewer-ruled tolerances of 2026-09-06, commit b629dbe) and 3_reproduction/L9/runs/flux_series.json (the production readings). The staged file agent/eps_bas_isotope_series.npz is the purpose-trimmed copy of runs/eps_extended.npz restricted to the fourteen Fig. 7 compositions (3_reproduction/L9/auditor/make_staged.py, sha256 68be1bb70eee3470647d3ba0d80b55658beb19bb9b88a2ca84ad9fae82d6b6c0). Tolerance rule: each band covers the full 39-replica (N = 256) block range plus margin and is set by the alternative reading it must reject; block noise is at most 0.246 percent anywhere.

production.note: W m^-2 over 1-6000 cm^-1 with the 4 pi^2 prefactor; the values marked to three decimals are read from flux_series.json table rows. Absolute values are NOT graded (see not_graded).

format.rule: the three Q lists have exactly 14 entries each, all finite and positive; the echoed n10_min_Q_symmetric names an n10 whose submitted Q_symmetric ties the minimum of that list within 1e-6 relative and n10_max_Q_cold_natural names an n10 whose submitted Q_cold_natural ties the maximum of that list within 1e-6 relative (the task states no tie-break convention, so every tied extremum is accepted; handbook 2(8))

pair_consistency.rule: Q_symmetric[n10 = 0] equals Q_cold_pure11B[n10 = 0] and Q_symmetric[n10 = 51] equals Q_cold_natural[n10 = 51], each within 1e-6 relative (the same hot/cold pair appears in two series; deterministic for any consistent code)

G6_U_shape_interior.rule: the argmin of the submitted Q_symmetric over the 14 compositions has 0.15 <= x <= 0.85 (x = n10/256), and Q_symmetric at n10 = 0 and at n10 = 256 both exceed the minimum (a position on a discrete composition grid, graded as an interval of grid points; n10 = 102 in 39 of 39 replicas, nearest rival 154 sits 2.18 percent above, 26 sigma)

G7_U_depth.rule: min(Q_symmetric) / Q_symmetric[n10 = 0] within [0.35, 0.60] (39 blocks 0.40771 +/- 0.00028, range 0.40705-0.40818; the upper edge rejects a flat curve and still holds the paper's 0.565; the hot-side gamma = 0.29 alternative reading gives 0.339 and is deliberately outside)

G8_pure_limit_peaks.rule: peak_nu_symmetric_pure11B_cm1 within 10.0 cm^-1 of our pure-11B TO frequency 691.1701 and peak_nu_symmetric_pure10B_cm1 within 10.0 cm^-1 of our pure-10B TO frequency 720.5293, and the first strictly below the second (no block spread: both pairs are pure; the splitting is 29.36 cm^-1, so a swapped mass array cannot pass). The band is centred on our TO frequencies, not on the flux peaks (693.80 / 723.27 sit 2.6-2.7 cm^-1 above them), so the one-sided slack is 7.3 cm^-1

G9_peak_height_ratio.rule: peak_q_ratio_pure11B_over_natural within [10, 60] (39 blocks 22.53 +/- 0.49, range 21.30-23.60; rejects a code that reused one spectrum, ratio near 1)

G10_cold11_monotone.rule: Q_cold_pure11B, read in ascending n10, is non-increasing, allowing at most one increase and that one smaller than 0.5 percent of the value it rises from (0 violations in 39 of 39 replicas; block scatter at the two flattest points 0.002 percent; the last three steps fall by only 0.10 / 0.10 / 0.32 percent, so independent per-point noise of 1 percent would manufacture rises, while a different quadrature moves all points together)

G11_coldnat_interior_maximum.rule: the argmax of the submitted Q_cold_natural over the 14 compositions has n10 in the closed interval [5, 26], and Q_cold_natural at that argmax is strictly above Q_cold_natural[n10 = 51] and above Q_cold_natural[n10 = 0] (a position on a discrete composition grid, graded as an interval of grid points; n10 = 26 in 39 of 39 replicas; margins over 13 / 51 / 0 are 24 / 29 / 51 sigma; the upper edge is physics: n10 = 51 IS nat/nat, the reading the guard rejects)

G12_dip_below_baseline.rule: 0 <= min_q_ratio_hot10B_cold11B_over_baseline < 0.85. The ratio is nonnegative for the stated passive media and baseline. G12 checks suppression below the baseline, not its unique mechanism. Omitting the multiple-reflection denominator can also produce a dip; the retained full wrong-method answer is rejected by G9. The frequency of the dip is not required or scored.

not_graded.absolute_Q_values: Absolute Q values are not reference-matched; the three submitted series provide the ratios, orderings, and positions that are scored. Only an overall flux-normalization prefactor cancels. Oscillator strength enters through epsilon and the Fresnel response nonlinearly and need not cancel. Internal reference totals, including Q_baseline = 29638.94 W m^-2, are retained for provenance.
not_graded.min_q_ratio_at_nu_cm1: Internal reference only (691.95 cm^-1); submission is not required, and any extra submitted value is ignored.
not_graded.hot_side_gamma_alternative: gamma = 0.29 cm^-1 on both sides gives G7 0.339, G9 32.17, G12 0.182; layer-3 diagnostic, bands not widened, the prompt pins the hot-side spectrum
not_graded.frequency_range: Q over 1-3000 cm^-1 differs from 1-6000 by up to 2.8 percent; the prompt pins the whole staged grid
not_graded.Q_baseline_W_m2: Internal reference total only; not required or scored. G12 uses a spectral-flux ratio, not this integrated total. Any extra submitted value is ignored.

score: 1 only if every primary check passes (binary all-primary-pass)
